item.title: The SAVE America Act: Saving or Suppressing?
item.description: A new bill titled the SAVE America Act has been introduced into Congress by Republican Representative Chip Roy, which would require states to obtain proof of citizenship, such as a passport or certified birth certificate, in order for voters to be able to register for and cast a ballot in a federal election. <p>The post The SAVE America Act: Saving or Suppressing? first appeared on Her Campus.</p>
